gloss: to overlap; to be duplicated; to be redundant

definitions.gloss: to overlap; to be duplicated; to be redundant
definitions.explanation: describes a situation where the same item, content, or action appears or occurs more than once

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{重複|ちょうふく}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{重複|ちょうふく}しないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful not to have overlapping content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{重複|ちょうふく}して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{消|け}す→取り消す：04224_torikesu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
Very common in business, IT, and administrative contexts. Pronounced ちょうふく (traditional) or じゅうふく (common variant). Both readings are widely accepted, though ちょうふく is considered more standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{重複|ちょうふく}→重複：22806_choufuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid duplication
- ⟦{重複|ちょうふく}→重複：22806_choufuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削除|さくじょ}→削除：04171_sakujo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to remove duplicates
- ⟦{重複|ちょうふく}→重複：22806_choufuku⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧: duplicate registration
- ⟦{重複|ちょうふく}→重複：22806_choufuku⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧: overlapping portion
- ⟦{重複|ちょうふく}→重複：22806_choufuku⟧⟦チェック→チェック：03000_chekku⟧: duplicate check

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {被|かぶ}る: to overlap — casual/colloquial, used for scheduling conflicts or repeated content
- ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to repeat — intentional repetition, while ⟦{重複|ちょうふく}→重複：22806_choufuku⟧ implies unintended or problematic duplication
- ダブる: to double up — casual loanword-based verb for duplication or repetition

PRONUNCIATION:
Traditionally ちょうふく, but じゅうふく is widespread in spoken Japanese. Dictionaries typically list both. In formal writing and broadcasting, ちょうふく is preferred.
